name: Archie card lane (Tackler cards go to Archie first: hold, false, one lever, or needs-operator)

knobs.note: BH-8817: 0 exits the tick before any read. Any value other than 0 runs.
BH-8817: the most archie-routed cards one tick claims per project, oldest first; the rest are logged deferred=<n> and the next tick takes them. Out of range is one warn line and the default.
BH-8817: the timeout of the one agent-call per card (stage archie-card). Out of range is one warn line and the default.
BH-8817: the outer timeout of one tick, inside the 10-minute cadence. Out of range is one warn line and the default.
BH-8817: the most bytes of the card and its evidence record inside the prompt's UNTRUSTED fence. Out of range is one warn line and the default.
BH-8817: the most characters of Archie's reason that bin/unblock-reply.sh archie sends as the answer note or the route reason (the worker's TEXT_MAX is 500). Out of range is the default.

BH-8817: the UNBLOCK_ACT value bin/archie-cards.sh gives Tackler's writer (bin/lib/unblock/act.sh ub_act) when Archie picks a lever. 0 = every lever answers would and the card goes to the operator with what Archie would have pulled. The project's unblock.project.

.mode row must also be act.
BH-8817: the lead-review request priority of Archie's re_review lever (ub_act lead_rerequest). Out of range is one warn line and the default.

BH-8817: the longest re_review brief Archie's lane passes to ub_act lead_rerequest; the brief is cut to it. The same bound act.sh reads (the unblock lane's knob of this name). Out of range is one warn line and the default 300.

0 makes this lane call no model at all. bin/lib/llm-gate.sh refuses BEFORE the vendor call and writes a zero-cost row_source=refused row, so the stop is visible in the ledger rather than being a lane that went quiet. Covers the one agent-call of this lane (stage archie-card); a card with no call times out to the operator through Tackler's sweep.
Comma/space list of the ONLY ladder rungs this lane may reach. Empty is every rung, i.e. today's ladder unchanged. A rung outside the list is refused before the call.
Dollars this lane may spend in the current UTC day, summed from D1 cost_rows through GET /api/metrics/llm-spend, never from the box's own logs/cost.csv.
Test seam: epoch seconds bin/archie-cards.sh uses as now, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane.
Test seam: a stub file bin/archie-cards.sh sources after its libs, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1 (tests/archie-cards.bh-8817-test.sh). NOT settable from the control plane.
Internal: 1 marks the run inside the outer timeout, so the script does not wrap itself twice. NOT settable from the control plane.
Test seam gate: bin/archie-cards.sh honours ARCHIE_CARDS_NOW and ARCHIE_CARDS_FIXTURE only when this is 1. Never set on a box, and NOT settable from the control plane.
